regions.merged_text: Conclusion of 40 ho'rs Dev. in 30th St. St.J. Bapt. Church. Fr. Bruno and Solanus with 13 Altar boys went to the procession, all served. They were G. Gorman Ch. O Hara, A. Dempsey, Wm Hayes, Tho's Mullen, Wm Ber- gen, Pat'k Laughlin, F.O Brien, G. Keegan, A Ciralli, Fr Gorman, Jas Smith and John Smith. Some of the boys behaved badly.

regions.merged_text: New Rule for Altar boys having been announced the Satur- day before was tried for first time i.e. in order to have the Altar boys give the good example they were to receive at the Holy Mass they served one day at 7 oclock and then serve the next day at 8.
